reader_hook: Electricity is becoming a constraint on economic growth not just a utility bill
company_examples: Constellation; Vistra; NRG; Exelon; Duke; AEP; NextEra; FPL
evidence_to_use: GW; PPAs; ESAs; rate-base plans; tariff/rider filings; capital plans; project status; recovery mechanisms
best_chapter_role: lead broad theme for AI infrastructure and utility scarcity
proof_boundary: Load forecasts and capex plans are not customer cash or project returns
next_writing_or_research_step: write power scarcity chapter with FPL/AEP/Duke/Constellation examples

reader_hook: Giant platforms are becoming the routes through which savings reach hard-to-access assets
company_examples: BlackRock; Blackstone; Apollo/Athene; KKR/Global Atlantic; Brookfield; Ares; Carlyle
evidence_to_use: AUM; FPAUM; insurance liabilities; statutory schedules; credit AUM; inflows; originations; named legal-entity holdings
best_chapter_role: proof backbone and big-money platform chapter
proof_boundary: Platform scale is not proof of borrower receipt settlement cash waterfall or final return
next_writing_or_research_step: write capital routing chapter with Accordia and Apollo/Athene boundaries

reader_hook: The scarce thing in healthcare is organized access under cost and labor pressure
company_examples: UnitedHealth; Cigna; DaVita; Option Care; Addus; BrightSpring; Enhabit
evidence_to_use: Revenue; medical-cost trend; pharmacy/service economics; patients served; admissions; census; reimbursement; labor productivity
proof_boundary: Demand for care does not prove durable reimbursement trust quality or cash conversion
next_writing_or_research_step: write healthcare access chapter from patient/payor/provider burden

reader_hook: Modern physical work fails when equipment parts technical support or project supply chains fail
company_examples: United Rentals; Fastenal; WESCO; Grainger; Applied Industrial; MSC; Watsco
evidence_to_use: Fleet productivity; OEC; rental revenue; vending/onsite locations; backlog; branch density; gross margin; OCF
proof_boundary: Sales and backlog are not proof of project-level collection or asset ROIC
next_writing_or_research_step: write uptime infrastructure chapter with URI and WESCO as anchors

reader_hook: Expensive housing and aging infrastructure shift demand toward repair maintenance replacement and contractor channels
company_examples: Home Depot; Lowes; Builders FirstSource; Sherwin-Williams; West Fraser; Ferguson; Core Main
evidence_to_use: RMI mix; Pro growth; waterworks demand; branch networks; coatings sales; lumber cycle data; cash conversion
proof_boundary: Housing exposure is not one thing because each sub-lane has different demand and margin risk
next_writing_or_research_step: write built-environment upkeep chapter around shelter as ongoing burden

reader_hook: More digital activity creates demand for permission security routing execution and governance
company_examples: Cloudflare; Akamai; Fastly; Zscaler; Fortinet; DigitalOcean; Roblox
evidence_to_use: ARR; RPO; deferred revenue; traffic/security demand; large contracts; AI workload evidence; FCF; safety/governance cost
proof_boundary: Digital growth does not automatically become operating leverage or durable control
next_writing_or_research_step: write digital control chapter around trust as infrastructure

reader_hook: Pressured households split the wallet by job not just by cheapest store
company_examples: Costco; Walmart; Target; Dollar General; Dollar Tree; Burlington; Ollies
evidence_to_use: Traffic; comps; basket; membership fees; ads; e-commerce; margin; shrink; inventory quality; digital growth
proof_boundary: Trade-down is too blunt because each retailer solves a different consumer anxiety
next_writing_or_research_step: write value retail chapter around regret management

reader_hook: Growth only matters if it turns into cash rather than getting trapped in receivables and inventory
company_examples: Target; Zebra; MSC; Global Industrial; Pool; Core Main; Arrow; Synchrony
evidence_to_use: DSO; inventory turns; reserves; customer concentration; borrowing-base eligibility; gross margin; OCF
proof_boundary: Revenue growth and balance-sheet growth are not cash realization
next_writing_or_research_step: build working-capital proof exhibit for later draft

reader_hook: Buying companies customers and backlog is only useful if it converts after close
company_examples: Sterling; MasTec; URI/Yak; Core Main; Relation; MAI; Frontline; Atwell
evidence_to_use: Purchase price; debt funding; acquired backlog; backlog burn; retainage; project margin; contract assets/liabilities; OCF
proof_boundary: Transaction size is not value creation or cash collection

reader_hook: Refinancing can create breathing room but can also just move risk forward
company_examples: PBF; Matador; Devon; Liberty Broadband; Verizon; Wheaton
evidence_to_use: Issuance proceeds; redemption amounts; maturities; coupon changes; fees; settlement; interest cost; liquidity; NPV model
proof_boundary: Principal and coupon mechanics are not proof of value creation
